note: Three provisional calibration cases, two grounded pairs and one deliberately ablated input. Excerpts from the listed public README blob revisions, with omitted intervening content. Not held-out or an independent benchmark; no experiment performed.

cases.question: Could the LAION expressive speech cases support a technically useful evaluation of Kyutai AURA?
cases.reference_rationale: Speech input and controlled expressive situations fit an exploratory avatar evaluation; no facial ground truth or cooperation proven.

evidence.text:
**266 hard cases for expressive-speech synthesis and annotation**, each written as a
short direction an actor could take, together with what it should do to the signal and
which measurable dimensions ought to move.

- **The detector tokens are intentions, not measurements.** They say which dimension
  *ought* to move; nobody has verified that it does.

AURA turns a single portrait image and a speech audio stream into a talking-head video, **chunk by chunk,
in streaming**. Each chunk needs only its own audio, with no multi-second look-ahead.
